description: Response import for migrations. Create a run from rows, dry-run a column mapping, confirm, then poll the run. Every step can be repeated.

steps.name: confirm
steps.requires: a dry run of the current mapping

resume: A run that stops (queued, running or failed) is continued with the resume step from `resume_from_row`. A row whose source id is already stored is skipped, so resuming and repeating an import never duplicates a record. A settled run cannot be resumed; create a new run from the rows that failed.
idempotency: Rows are identified by the value of `source_id_column`, stored as `source_id_prefix` followed by that value. Without a source id column the row number is used, which only makes a repeat safe for the same file.

checksum.algorithm: sha256 over the source ids sorted as strings and joined with a newline
checksum.expected: dry_run.source_id_checksum, the stored ids (source_id_prefix plus the source id value) this run will write
checksum.stored: reconcile.stored_checksum, the ids stored by this run
checksum.balanced: reconcile.balanced is true when every row was processed, none failed and the two checksums are equal

reverse_route: rollback removes exactly the records this run wrote (queued) and nothing written by other runs or by hand.
